purpose: Negation and rationale controls for reasoning traceability.

rules.trigger: A cited stated_rationale for reasoning_traceability matches "not|no|never|without" followed within two words by "need|needs|needed|require|requires|required|because|based on". Such a rationale is not counted; if no other non-negated rationale or source reference is cited, reasoning is review_required with reason "negated_rationale_not_counted".
rules.limitation: Bounded lexical negation; other negation forms and double negatives are not interpreted.
rules.false_positive_risk: A sentence such as "not because of cost, but because ..." is routed to review although it states a reason.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.
